# Kingdom Connects

> A faith-based platform connecting churches and Christian businesses to build the Kingdom economy.

## About This Site

Kingdom Connects is a directory and community platform that:
- Connects local Christian businesses with churches and members
- Facilitates discovery, listing, and reviews of faith-based businesses
- Supports churches through a 10% tithe from Pro business subscriptions
- Builds sustainable Christian commerce within communities

## Site Structure

### Public Pages
- `/` - Landing page
- `/business_directory.html` - Browse businesses
- `/church_directory.html` - Browse churches
- `/for-businesses.html` - Business signup and pricing
- `/business/:slug.htm` - Individual business pages (SSR)
- `/church/:slug.htm` - Individual church pages (SSR)

### User Dashboards (Authentication Required)
- `/member/` - Member dashboard (favorites, reviews)
- `/business-admin/` - Business owner dashboard
- `/church-admin/` - Church administrator dashboard
- `/sales/` - Sales agent dashboard
- `/admin/` - Platform admin dashboard

## Key Features

### For Businesses
- Free basic listings
- Pro tier ($9/month or $69.99/year) with enhanced features:
  - Priority search placement
  - Distance search visibility
  - Analytics dashboard
  - Review responses
  - Promotions, products, testimonials
  - Gold Pro badge

### For Members
- Save favorite businesses
- Write and manage reviews
- Find businesses at their church
- Distance-based search (Pro businesses)

### For Churches
- Manage affiliated businesses
- Receive 10% tithe from Pro subscriptions
- Church directory listing

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6 modules)
- Backend: Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Storage, Hosting)
- API Server: Node.js with Express
- Email: Resend integration
- Payments: Stripe integration

## API Endpoints

### Public
- `GET /sitemap.xml` - Dynamic sitemap
- `GET /business/:slug.htm` - SSR business page
- `GET /church/:slug.htm` - SSR church page

### Authenticated
- `POST /api/send-email` - Send transactional email
- `POST /api/generate-presentation` - Generate PowerPoint

## Data Collections (Firestore)
- `users` - User profiles and roles
- `business_listings` - Business directory entries
- `churches` - Church directory entries
- `reviews` - Business reviews
- `categories` - Business categories
- `email_templates` - Email template management
- `pricing_settings` - Dynamic pricing configuration
- `activity_log` - Audit trail

## Contact
- Website: kingdomconnects.org
- Purpose: Building the Kingdom economy through faith-based commerce
